input.why: mp_right_puff is the gesture family behind 3 of 5 recorded games (60%) for this key, with 'tap 250' as the single most common function (40%, e.g. The Last of Us Part II) versus 'normal' or 'delay_on 200' at 20% each.
mp_triple_sip_soft (normal) is their choice for this button in 14 of 35 games (40%), well ahead of the next gesture (mp_left_puff delay_on 75, 17%).
mp_right_puff (delay_on 100) is their choice for this button in 15 of 39 games (38%), well ahead of the next gesture (mp_left_center_puff normal, 18%).
mp_left_puff_soft is their dominant gesture for this button, used in 21 of 33 games (63%) combined across timings; 'normal' is the more common of those two functions (39% vs 24% for delay_on 250).

input.summary: Settled all clearly evidenced controls (movement arrows, jump, attack, bind, journal, needolin, quick map, pause, and their gamepad/analog equivalents) using dominant or unanimous past gestures. Asked the user to choose between closely-split historical gestures for dash, harpoon, tool-use, inventory, and crest-switch (both keyboard and gamepad versions), since their history didn't clearly favor one option for those. Also asked about right_stick (unclear in-game use) and confirmed as 'leave unassigned' for all controls with no corresponding action in Silksong's control list (D-pad directions, E, F1, H, Left Control, Left Shift, W, right mouse button), since binding those would mean inventing a function with no in-game target.
